basis: T3 D2 revision 5b.3 §4.11.2-§4.11.5 (option C, conservative interval binding)
notice: Invented values only; no protected standards content and no professional, certification or code-compliance claim. Inputs and expected enclosures are binary64 bit patterns; formula literals are short decimals that every JSON reader parses exactly. An input binds [next_down(q-b), next_up(q+b)] when b > 0 and the exact point q when b = 0. Truth values: T (every value passes), F (every value fails), U (indeterminate, never a pass). A negative control must never read T.
